claims.claim: The Iowa corn/soybean sampling reference uses a six-inch depth; consistent sampling depth matters for comparable results.
claims.statistic: Source sampling/calibration context, not a crop pH requirement
claims.locator: Best practices for soil sampling paragraph, sentences on corn/soybean sampling depth
limitations: No cultivar-specific requirement or field applicability approval.
Six inches is retained as reported; it is not the SoilGrids 0–5 cm layer.
Do not transfer Iowa sampling/calibration guidance to Myanmar without local review.
No amendment, fertilizer or crop suitability recommendation is generated.
